Package smart_food_delivery.domain

Class StandardOrder

java.lang.Object
smart_food_delivery.domain.Order
smart_food_delivery.domain.StandardOrder
public class StandardOrder extends Order
Represents a standard delivery order in the Smart Food Delivery Management System. This class extends the Order class and follows the normal order and delivery policies without adding any express delivery fees.
